faq.q: What time are Sunday worship services?
faq.a: Sunday worship is at 10:45 AM  (Central). Christian Education begins at 9:45 AM.

faq.q: Is there something for my children?
faq.a: Yes. Children's ministry and nursery are available during services with secure check‑in and loving volunteers.
Come as you are – you'll see everything from casual jeans to business casual. We care more that you're here than what you wear.
Most services last about 60–70 minutes including worship, teaching, and closing prayer.
Yes. Our Sunday 10:45 AM service streams live on YouTube and is archived for on‑demand viewing.

hero.title: What We Believe
hero.subtitle: Here's a simple summary of what we hold to be true. If you have questions, we'd love to talk with you.

beliefsPage.motto: In essentials, unity; in non-essentials, liberty; in all things, charity.

closing.title: Have Questions?
closing.text: Faith questions are welcome here. Join us on a Sunday or reach out to Pastor Rick - we'd be glad to talk.

beliefs.title: Scripture
beliefs.summary: We believe the Bible is the inspired and authoritative Word of God, sufficient for faith and life.

scripture.title: God
scripture.summary: One God eternally existing in three persons: Father, Son, and Holy Spirit.

scripture.title: Jesus Christ
scripture.summary: Fully God and fully man, whose life, death, and resurrection provide salvation to all who believe.

scripture.title: The Holy Spirit
scripture.summary: The Holy Spirit lives in every believer, giving new life, guiding us into truth, and empowering us to live for Christ.

scripture.title: Humanity & Sin
scripture.summary: Every person is created in God's image and deeply loved by Him, yet all have sinned and need His forgiveness.

scripture.title: Salvation
scripture.summary: By grace through faith in Christ alone—not by works—resulting in new life and hope.

scripture.title: The Church
scripture.summary: A community of believers called to worship, discipleship, fellowship, service, and mission.

scripture.title: Baptism & Communion
scripture.summary: Jesus gave the church baptism as a public sign of new life in Him, and the Lord's Supper as a way to remember His sacrifice until He returns.

scripture.title: Christ's Return & Eternity
scripture.summary: Jesus will return one day to make all things new, and those who trust in Him will live with God forever.
